responsibility: Implements the IPA pass that strips or canonicalizes front-end language-specific tree data before middle-end/LTO processing. It walks all reachable functions, variables, decls, and types from the cgraph and varpool, preserves needed assembler names first, then rewrites or frees language-dependent decl/type payloads, resets language hooks and diagnostics to middle-end variants, and rebuilds the type inheritance graph afterward. Its purpose is IL regularization and memory reduction, not optimization of calls or dataflow.
